scope: One image generation for the generic ME1 asari commando family; fixed pose drawings, no pixel edits or new mechanical kit.

args.prompt:
Create one production sprite atlas derived ONLY from the blue asari commando in the BOTTOM RIGHT of the supplied reference image. The other seven reference characters are context only and MUST NOT appear. This is a generic hostile Mass Effect 1 asari commando for a French 2D-HD/3D JRPG, not Matriarch Benezia, not Liara, not the Thorian clone. Preserve the reference identity: adult realistic proportions, blue skin, swept-back cranial ridges instead of hair, stern blue face, fitted matte black and dark violet segmented combat armor with purple chest/shoulder bands, dark gloves and armored boots. No human hair, no helmet, no cape, no new costume, no visible text or logos.

TECHNICAL COMPOSITION: a clean 1536 by 1024 transparent RGBA PNG with exactly FOUR ENTIRE ISOLATED bodies in a spacious 2 by 2 layout. Each figure must stay completely inside its own quadrant with large transparent gutters and at least 50 pixels of clear transparent space between silhouettes. No grid lines, labels, borders, backdrop, checkerboard, scenery, floor, ground shadow, glow, particles or smoke. Keep lighting, face, armor colors, adult anatomy, perspective and physical pixel scale consistent across all four poses. Soft neutral front-left studio illumination, detailed precalculated realistic HD game sprite, crisp readable body silhouette, not chibi or pixel art. Three-quarter orthographic game camera, standing figures facing left/front-left as the reference enemy aims left. All fingers, cranial ridges, weapon barrels, both feet and boot soles must be fully included, with no part cropped by an image or quadrant edge.

TOP LEFT: AIM. Entire standing alert asari in a mild combat crouch, holding the same compact futuristic pistol in both hands and aiming toward the left. Boots firmly on one shared baseline, clearly separated legs.
TOP RIGHT: POWER. The same entire standing asari braces for her existing biotic throw or barrier action: left open hand extends forward, other hand holds the compact pistol close to the body. Hands are joined naturally through arms to the body. NO glowing orb, no aura and no baked ability effects.
BOTTOM LEFT: HIT. The same entire asari recoils from a hit with torso leaning back slightly and shoulders turned, keeping balance and both feet visible. Pistol remains in her hand, no blood or wounds, no detached objects.
BOTTOM RIGHT: DOWN. The same entire asari lies safely knocked out on her side, head toward the left, feet toward the right, one arm and the same pistol resting against the torso so that the silhouette stays contiguous. Both legs and all cranial ridges included, no blood, no pool and no separate weapon. The horizontal body must be no larger in physical pixel scale than a standing figure rotated on the ground.

Give each pose its own simple, single connected silhouette wherever practical. Make the three upright bodies roughly 380 pixels high and the prone body about 430 pixels long, keeping abundant transparent padding. These are four fixed pose drawings, not a motion blur strip or a scene.

generations.reason: Native RGBA image has four separated visible components, fits four independent UV rectangles with eight pixels of padding, and passes actual native-size browser image inspection.
